Use the {{medawatch}}'s <c:ff00ff>command screen<c>
and give me some <c:ff00ff>orders<c>.

Use the {{medawatch}}'s <c:ff00ff>command screen<c>
and give me some <c:ff00ff>orders<c>.
Leave it to me!

The basics: use a {{part}}'s "actions."
Attack, support, heal... they vary.

Pick a {{part}} to use with the D-Pad.
$ｻ selects the head {{part}}.

Info on the selected {{part}} shows
in the status window above.
This icon is the <c:00ffe6>{{pierce|cap}} Mark<c>.

{{pierce|cap}} attacks that {{destroy}} a {{part}}
deal extra {{damage}} to the head.

The head is stronger than other {{part|pl}},
but it only has a few uses.

The {{remaining}} uses are shown
on this gauge.

Press <c:00ffe6>$ｽ<c> on the <c:00ffe6>D-Pad<c> to
select the <c:ff00ff>right arm<c>.
This icon $0 shows <c:00ffe6>{{pierce}} damage<c>.

{{pierce|cap}} attacks that {{destroy}} a {{part}}
deal extra {{damage}} to the head.

Press <c:00ffe6>$ｼ<c> on the <c:00ffe6>D-Pad<c> and
select the <c:ff00ff>left arm<c>.

Now the <c:ff00ff>left {{arm_part}}<c> - press <c:00ffe6>$ｼ<c>.
The <c:ff00ff>left arm<c> pierces too!

The head can't attack. Let's fight
with the arms, which are unlimited.

Unlike the head, arm {{part|pl}} can be used
any number of times. Fight with them.

Press <c:00ffe6>$ｾ<c> on the <c:00ffe6>D-Pad<c> and
pick the <c:ff00ff>legs<c>.

{{legs}} have no actions, but they affect
every ability of a {{medabot}}.

They have a passive {{effect}},
the "<c:ff00ff>{{leg_trait}}<c>."

Now, let's decide the first command!
Pick any {{part}} except the legs...

Let's try an attack first.
Pick one of the arm {{part|pl}}...

Confirm the command with the $*
button.
Alright, let the {{robattle}} begin!
